title: This is how hackers hack you using simple social engineering
summary: A short clip demonstrating a phone-based social engineering trick in which a crying baby in the background is used to pressure a customer service rep. It shows how attackers exploit human sympathy rather than technical flaws.
why: Cited as a funny and effective real example of social engineering whenever support-desk account takeovers and human weak points are discussed.

quote.text: Here's a pretty hilarious and effective example where a crying baby background was used
